scope: Five-minute releases, direction, distance and reciprocal exchanges; role/route screens are separate. Midfield invitation counters do not claim completed receptions.

definitions.sampled: one-second in-play exposure, not independent events; mean forward gap uses forward_observations
definitions.events: canonical action sequence plus unique carry-intent/aerial contact IDs; opportunities include unsuccessful contacts; unresolved counters describe the final endpoint
definitions.secondBalls: first actual owner acquisition within 8s of aerial contact, before restart/shot; temporal lineage, not causal attribution
definitions.trace: first 96 examples; shape: first 32 team samples
definitions.takeOns: unique wide carry intents with nearest non-keeper opponent within 8m and not already more than 1m behind; passed marker requires >1m goalward lead with actual control. Ending outcomes are control states, not universal dribble success/failure; released_or_loose includes deliberate passes and knock-ons.
definitions.behindLine: canonical pass/through-pass releases with physical target >0.5m beyond the pre-release legal defender/ball/halfway line; outcome follows the same canonical parent ID. A target is not proof of reception or a successful depth run.

definitions.trace: first 96 examples; shape: first 32 team samples
definitions.takeOns: unique wide carry intents with nearest non-keeper opponent within 8m and not already more than 1m behind; passed marker requires >1m goalward lead with actual control. Ending outcomes are control states, not universal dribble success/failure; released_or_loose includes deliberate passes and knock-ons.
definitions.behindLine: canonical pass/through-pass releases with physical target >0.5m beyond the pre-release legal defender/ball/halfway line; outcome follows the same canonical parent ID. A target is not proof of reception or a successful depth run.
